job_posting.title: Cloud Engineer Focus: Security Patching  Remediation
job_posting.description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us Extensive leave up to 21 - 22 days per year English speaking working environment Hybrid working mode The Job

As a Cloud Engineering, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Own and execute security patching deployment and vulnerability remediation across cloud and hybrid environments (Windows and Linux).
  • Operate and manage enterprise patching and vulnerability tools, including SCCM, Qualys Patch Management, and similar solutions.
  • Partner with security teams to follow up on vulnerability findings, perform risk remediation, and track compliance status.
  • Automate patching workflows, compliance checks, and operational tasks using PowerShell and Linux shell scripting.
  • Participate in cloud platform operations, including project delivery, BAU support, and ad-hoc engineering tasks.
  • Design, build, and optimize secure cloud infrastructure with reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency in mind.
  • Develop and maintain clear technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate closely with SRE, security, network, and application teams.
  • Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements aligned with business and security requirements.
  • Participate in change, incident, and problem management processes following ITIL practices.
Your Skills and Experience
  • 2–3+ years of experience in cloud engineering, system administration, or infrastructure roles.
  • Proven hands-on experience in security patching and vulnerability remediation.
  • Strong operational experience with Windows and Linux systems.
  • Hands-on experience with PowerShell and Linux shell scripting.
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Azure and cloud operating environments.
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (IP, DNS, load balancing).
  • Experience with Qualys, SCCM, or similar vulnerability management tools.
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps practices and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform and Ansible is an advantage.
  • Exposure to enterprise monitoring tools such as Elastic is a plus.
  • Proficiency in English, with the ability to handle English documents and communicate independently with clients.
Why You'll Love Working Here
  • Attractive salary and benefits  
  • Hybrid working mode
  • Full salary in probation & 13th month salary
  • Social insurance on full salary from probation
  • Extensive leave up to 18 days per year
  • Quarterly team building activities
  • Annual health check
  • Personal accident insurance

job_posting.title: Senior Data Engineer CRM
job_posting.skills: Data Engineer, CI/CD, SQL, Python, Data modeling, ELT
job_posting.description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us Positive work environment, support & determination Very attractive salary & benefits Development opportunities & improve a quality life The Job

1. Primary Objective:

  • Design and build scalable batch and real-time ETL/ELT data pipelines
  • Design data models and DataMarts (Customer Profile, Journey, Event) per business requirements
  • Operate, monitor, and optimize the data platform on Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud
  • Integrate source systems and provide technical support to other teams in the Data Department
  • Ensure data quality and adherence to data governance standards across pipelines
  • Provide technical guidance, code review, and knowledge sharing within the team

2. Main Responsibilities

  • Build and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL/Python from trading, CRM, and APIs; directly operate CDC flow via Debezium on GKE Autopilot to Azure Databricks
  • Design DataMarts using Medallion/Data Vault architecture; collaborate with stakeholders and vendors to clarify requirements and integrate CDP/CRM
  • Manage, operate, and monitor resources/costs on Azure (Databricks, ADF, Synapse/Fabric, ADLS) and Google Cloud (GKE Autopilot, Pub/Sub)
  • Monitor pipelines, troubleshoot incidents, automate alerting, and continuously improve system performance
  • Implement automated data quality checks, reconciliation, and defect handling (using Great Expectations or equivalent)
  • Integrate core trading, CRM, and accounting source systems; lead data migrations/upgrades with zero data loss or downtime
  • Implement IAM access control, encryption, and data masking; perform backup/recovery and establish CI/CD workflows via Git and Azure DevOps
  • Support Analytics, Data Science, and Governance teams in data usage; mentor Data Engineers and review their code

3. Other Responsibilities

  • Maintain technical documentation, research new data technologies, and handle ad-hoc data requests
  • Perform other tasks as assigned by the Data Engineering Manager
Your Skills and Experience

1. Educational level

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Data Science or a related field

2. Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer with strong ETL/ELT pipeline development and large-scale data modeling
  • Advanced SQL proficiency and hands-on experience with cloud data platforms (Azure Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse, Snowflake, Spark)
  • Familiarity with CDP/CRM ecosystems and data integration with marketing platforms (Facebook Ads, Google Analytics, Criteo, RTB House)
  • Practical experience with workflow orchestration and transformation tools (dbt, Airflow, Azure Data Factory)
  • Strong Python skills for data processing, automation, and API integration (Scala/Java for Spark is a plus)
  • Experience with real-time event streaming technologies (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Event Hub)
  • Knowledge of Data Governance (data quality, lineage, catalog) and frameworks like Great Expectations or Soda
  • Experience with CI/CD for data engineering (Git, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) and exposure to Docker/Kubernetes
  • Prior involvement in enterprise-scale CDP/CRM integration projects

3. Professional Competencies/Knowledge

  • Data Classification and Archiving
  • Data Management Process Understanding
  • Data Analysis Knowledge
  • CRM System Knowledge
  • Data Architecture Knowledge
  • Database Management Knowledge
  • Data Recovery Knowledge
  • Information Technology Knowledge
  • Project Management Knowledge
Why You'll Love Working Here

Understanding candidates' expectations of the ideal workplace, we always put the people element at the top of our priorities. ​

Primary benefits:

  • Attractive KPI Bonus annual
  • Review Salary and performance annual
  • 16+ Annual Leaves​, 5 sick leaves, 1 day off birthday
  • Full Social Insurance, Annual Medical Check- up​, Health insurance
  • Team Building and company activities: Year- end Party, New-year Party, Company trip, Charity activities
  • Learning workshops: e-learning, English courses, career development training programs​
  • Sports clubs: gym, yoga, running, football, tennis, badminton

job_posting.title: Quality engineer/Tester Manual + auto- Upto 28M net
job_posting.description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us Làm việc với các đội ngũ trẻ tài năng và máu lửa Môi trường làm việc thoải mái, năng động Sản phẩm của người Việt chinh phục toàn cầu The Job
  • Analyze business and system requirements to identify testing scope and create effective test scenarios and test cases.
  • Execute manual testing for web/mobile applications, including Functional, Regression, Integration, Smoke, and UAT testing.
  • Detect, document, track, and verify software defects throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Work closely with Developers, Business Analysts, Product Managers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and ensure product quality.
  • Participate in requirement reviews to identify gaps, ambiguities, and potential risks from a QA perspective.
  • Prepare test reports and provide timely updates on testing progress, quality status, and identified issues.
  • Contribute to improving QA processes, testing documentation, and best practices.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams 
     
Your Skills and Experience
  • At least 1,5 years of experience in Software Testing, both in Manual & Auto test with a strong QA mindset.
  • Background in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related fields.
  • Good understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
  • Experience in designing test scenarios, writing test cases, executing test plans, and managing defects.
  • Familiarity with bug tracking and project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Redmine, or similar.
  • Basic knowledge of databases and SQL for data validation.
  • Basic understanding of RESTful APIs and experience using tools such as Postman for API testing is a plus.
  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team.
  • Eager to learn new technologies and continuously improve testing knowledge
  • Experience using AI to assist in writing/reviewing test cases, with the ability to verify AI output before use, is a plus.
  • Experience in the payment or e-commerce domain is a plus. 
     
Why You'll Love Working Here

Chúng tôi xây dựng môi trường làm việc nơi con người được trân trọng, ghi nhận và phát triển bền vững.


Thu nhập & Thưởng:
 

  • Mức lương NET cạnh tranh, chi trả minh bạch, thu nhập thực nhận rõ ràng
  • Thu nhập lên tới 16 tháng lương/năm, gồm lương tháng 13 cố định, thưởng hiệu suất kinh doanh theo quý lên đến 02 tháng lương/năm, dựa trên kết quả cá nhân và công ty

Thời gian làm việc & Nghỉ ngơi:
 

  • 24 ngày làm việc từ xa mỗi năm, linh hoạt và chủ động
  • 12 ngày phép năm, cộng thêm các ngày nghỉ lễ theo quy định
  • Giờ làm việc linh hoạt, từ Thứ 2 đến Thứ 6, đảm bảo cân bằng công việc – cuộc sống

Chăm sóc sức khỏe & Phúc lợi:
 

  • Khám sức khỏe định kỳ hằng năm
  • Đóng BHXH đầy đủ theo quy định pháp luật
  • Câu lạc bộ thể thao nội bộ (Cầu lông, bóng đá,...) khuyến khích lối sống lành mạnh
  • Du lịch công ty, hoạt động gắn kết đội ngũ được tổ chức thường xuyên

Phát triển sự nghiệp & Môi trường làm việc:
 

  • Cơ hội làm việc trong môi trường Global B2B SaaS đang tăng trưởng nhanh
  • Lộ trình phát triển và thăng tiến rõ ràng, tốc độ nhanh dựa trên năng lực
  • Làm việc cùng đội ngũ chuyên nghiệp và giàu kinh nghiệm
  • Không gian làm việc hiện đại, cởi mở, đề cao sự tin tưởng, trao quyền và phát triển con người

Chúng tôi tin rằng một môi trường làm việc tốt không chỉ giúp bạn thành công trong sự nghiệp, mà còn đồng hành cùng bạn trên hành trình phát triển dài hạn.

job_posting.title: Data Product  Semantic Layer Engineer
job_posting.skills: Data Engineer, English, Python, SQL, Databricks
job_posting.description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us Global Exposure Fast Track Career Diversified Jobs & Technologies The Job
  • Design, build and optimize Data Products using a medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) to support business reporting, analytics and AI use cases. 
  • Develop and maintain data pipelines, workflows and data transformations using Databricks, SQL, Python/PySpark and Delta Lake. 
  • Design and manage reusable data models, business metrics and semantic layers to enable consistent data consumption across teams. 
  • Establish and maintain data governance standards through Unity Catalog, including metadata, lineage, ownership and access controls.
  • Improve data quality, freshness, observability and trustworthiness through monitoring, validation and automated testing. 
  • Configure, maintain and continuously improve Databricks Genie by defining business context, trusted queries, benchmark questions and evaluation processes. 
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, data owners, SMEs, platform and AI teams to understand requirements and deliver scalable data solutions.
  • Produce clear technical documentation and ensure solutions are maintainable and reusable. 
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to knowledge sharing and capability development within the team.
Your Skills and Experience

Technical Skills 

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Products, Analytics Engineering, or related data platform roles.

job_posting.skills: Data Analysis, English, AI, Business Intelligence, Business Analysis, SQL
job_posting.description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us Profitable startup from Year 1! High pay, MacBook Pro, $1000 annual development Work with top talent on product changing industry The Job

About The Opportunity

The Data Team at Flodesk is part of our Engineering Team, based in our Da Nang office. We serve as the single source of truth for the company, providing data-driven insights that empower teams across Product, Marketing, Finance, and Engineering. 

As a Data Analyst, you’ll play a crucial role in translating raw data into meaningful insights, optimizing data pipelines, and maintaining a self-service BI ecosystem that enables teams to explore and understand data effectively.

What you will do

  • Financial metrics and modeling: Own the dbt models behind Flodesk’s financial metrics, from MRR and its movements to billings, collected payments, retention, LTV, and CAC. Build them from Recurly billing data so they hold up through real-world cases like plan changes, failed payments, and refunds, and so the same month shows the same number in every report.
  • Revenue and cost reconciliation: Reconcile billings, collected payments, and MRR against the billing system, payment processors, and accounting records, and explain any gap in terms Finance can act on. Do the same for costs, so unit economics like affiliate commissions rest on numbers everyone trusts.
  • Finance partnership: Work directly with our Finance Director and leadership on metric definitions, cohort and pricing analysis, and recurring reporting. When a definition is genuinely open (say, how to count a member who converts and cancels in the same month), lay out the options and trade-offs, help Finance decide, and document the decision so it sticks. Partner with Marketing on acquisition spend and attribution for CAC.
  • Beyond finance: Support other domains when needs arise, such as product and growth analytics, bringing the same rigor to questions about feature adoption, funnels, and retention.
  • AI-first analytics: Do most of your building and analysis through AI agents rather than by hand. You’ll direct agents to write and review dbt models, run investigations, and build dashboards, and you’ll own the result: checking the logic, testing edge cases, and catching what the agent got wrong.
  • Self-serve analytics, rebuilt: We’re replacing traditional BI with a self-hosted portal of Claude-built dashboards, plus an analytics MCP that answers ad hoc questions in plain language. You’ll build and maintain the finance dashboards, and curate the metric definitions, model metadata, and guardrails that keep MCP answers accurate.
Your Skills and Experience

What you need to be successful

  • Analytics experience, ideally in subscription or SaaS finance.
  • A fast learner with an open mind. Prior experience with subscription metrics such as MRR, LTV/CAC, or billing reconciliation is welcome but not required.
  • Advanced SQL and data modeling. You pick the right grain for each table and get snapshot and point-in-time logic right. dbt experience is a strong plus (our stack is dbt on Redshift and ClickHouse), and Python is a plus.
  • Experience doing analytics work through AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) is highly desirable, and building an analytics MCP server or semantic layer for LLM use even more so. Either way, you have the judgment to check an agent’s output rather than trust it.
  • Rigor and healthy skepticism. When numbers don’t tie, you keep digging until you can explain the gap, and you’re upfront about caveats and definitional choices instead of presenting one tidy number.
  • Clear written and spoken English. You can explain a metric definition to Finance without jargon, and write documentation that people (and agents) can rely on.
Why You'll Love Working Here

We’re a profitable, fast-growing startup building email marketing software used by thousands of small businesses. 

Why join us

  • Impact: Your work directly helps small business owners grow.
  • Culture: We’re a lean team that keeps things clear, holds a high bar for craft, stays curious, and builds with care. We work async-friendly and collaborate closely with our US and EU teams.
  • Perks: 
    • We pay highly competitive salaries, plus a 13th-month bonus.
    • Stock options for high contributors, because we want you to own a part of our success.
    • Professional development: up to $1,000/year for courses, books, or conferences.
    • Healthcare: annual health check, vaccinations, premium health insurance, and family health insurance covering up to 2 family members.
    • Flexible working hours with a standard 5-day workweek.
    • Equipment: a MacBook Pro, a Mac Studio for running AI agents (for most engineering roles), and an external screen in our modern office.
    • Career growth: overseas opportunities.

If you want to build software with a small, collaborative team, we’d like to hear from you. Apply now.
